en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what Angie's fantasy is,
with her head always full of Atua...

Hey, hey Shuichi! I'm bored!
Bored, bored, bored, bored, bored!

I outrank you, so if you don't do something
about my boredom, I hafta punish you.
Ah, you outrank me?

That's right! I have seniority cuz I'm older
and wiser than you.

Hmmm, why are you pretending to play
dumb? Is this a new game we're playing?
Ah, no, not at all...

<CLT=cltMIND>We're the same age...
but in Angie's fantasy, she has seniority?

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I have to act the part.
I don't want Angie to feel bad...

Look, Shuichi!
Look how bored I am!

Atua says...a low-rank who lets a high-rank
be bored, gets points deducted.

Ah, um, well then...
What should I do?

<CLT=cltMIND>Before I could concoct a plan,
Angie gave me an answer...of sorts.
Hiiii-yah!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*slam*!
Whaaaugh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie slammed her body
into me, knocking me over.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*bam*!
W-Wait, Angie, what are you doing!?

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed creaked as we toppled onto it.
I tried to get to my feet, but...
Nyahahahahaha! Gotcha, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie giggled like a schoolgirl as she straddled
my knee. Ah...well, more like my thigh.

Angie, y-you're not a kid...
Get off...

Mm-hm! This is a divine bed.
I think we can have fun here.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Nope, she's not listening.
Hey, hey Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie peeked at me
with teasing eyes.
What's poking me?
Wh-What are you talking about!?
Nyahahahaha!
What could it be?
What, indeed?

<CLT=cltMIND>Please, no jokes like that while
we're in this position...
Hey, Shuichi! I wanna play some more.
Wh-What are you trying to play...?
Oh, y'know...the usual.

Since you won't come up with something
fun to do, we'll play the usual game.
The usual...?
Hmmm? You're still not used to our game.

But that's okay! You always do whatever
I tell you, Shuichi.
That's what I like about you the most!
Whoa!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie leaned forward
and embraced me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, with the way she was positioned,
her chest pushed right against my face!

Ah, ah, um, Angie...
Y-You're...touching...
I know. I'm doing it on purpose.
What?

I like you, Shuichi. I like watching you get
filled with divine fervor.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie straightened her body, peeking
down at me with an impish smile.

<CLT=cltMIND>I recognized that smile...
but it felt a bit naughtier than usual.

Hey, Shuichi? What do you want me to do
to you today?
What do I want you to do...?

I wanna see you get filled with divine
fervor, just like this.
*gulp!*

<CLT=cltMIND>A shiver ran through
my body.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie's fingertips danced against
the nape of my neck.
Wh-What...are you...doing...?

Nyahahaha.
You like that, huh Shuichi?
I know you do... Atua told me so.

<CLT=cltMIND>Still smiling, her fingers began tracing
over my body, lower, lower still...

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie is small... I could probably
throw her off of me if I wanted to...

<CLT=cltMIND>But those fingers...
I felt totally helpless!
Hurgh! Stop! H-Hey!

Heyyyy! You can't talk to a high-rank
like that. Atua will get angry, y'know?
Ahhh!

So I'll punish you instead. I'll mete out
punishment in Atua's place.
A-Angie! Hey, Angie, enough!

You're so cute, Shuichi... I'm the only one
who gets to see this side of you.
Ah... Ah...

That's enough punishment for you.
It seems Atua is satisfied.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's a relief...
She was getting...pretty close...

Now it's your turn.
Make sure I have lots of fun, okay?
...Huh?

Time to play, Shuichi! Play until we've
reached sweaty salvation!
Ah! Ahhhhhh!
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
